description: Fails without the fix: in a non-example dotenv file the entropy scanner took the whole value as one candidate and skipped values over 256 characters, so a quoted secret inside a JSON-valued variable was never examined (line 4, ~420 characters). A short JSON value (line 5) was examined as one blob, not member by member. Now a value over the cap, or one starting with { or [, is read for its quoted members, each judged by its own key.
